item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find credible 2023 evidence that Putin generally kept formal commitments when those commitments constrained his war aims. The strongest pro-side evidence is limited to one crisis-containment statement about Wagner and a few declaratory policy texts. The stronger overall pattern is conditional commitments, rhetorical hedging, and active information control.","evidence":[{"title":"Updated Russian foreign-policy concept","publisher":"Kremlin","date":"Mar. 31, 2023","url":"https://www.kremlin.ru/acts/bank/49090/print","summary":"Putin signed a foreign-policy concept that publicly emphasized strategic stability, arms control, nonproliferation, and reducing nuclear risk. This is the best pro-7B.8 evidence, but it is declaratory language rather than a verified pattern of keeping commitments in practice.","question_ids":["7B.8"]},{"title":"Putin says he let Wagner mutiny continue to avoid bloodshed","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Jun. 26, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russias-putin-says-he-let-mutiny-continue-to-avoid-bloodshed-3113594","summary":"Putin said he deliberately let the Wagner mutiny run its course to avoid bloodshed. This is the clearest pro-side item, but it is narrow crisis management and does not show a general habit of honoring commitments or speaking honestly about tradeoffs.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"Russia says it does not reject talks with Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Jul. 29, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-does-not-reject-talks-with-ukraine-3138321","summary":"Putin said Russia was ready for negotiations and did not reject talks, but the offer was heavily conditional and tied to Russian-defined terms. That is diplomacy in form, not a reliable commitment to compromise.","question_ids":["7B.8"]},{"title":"Putin says Russia is ready to talk on Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Dec. 19, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-is-ready-to-talk-on-ukraine-3259822","summary":"Putin again said Russia was prepared to talk with Ukraine, the U.S., and Europe, but only on the basis of Moscow’s national interests. That is another conditional opening, not evidence of stable promise-keeping.","question_ids":["7B.8"]},{"title":"Russia’s updated foreign-policy concept and tactical-nuclear posture","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Sept. 29, 2023","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russias-2024-defense-spending-rise-record-share-budget-2023-09-29/","summary":"Reuters reported Russia’s defense spending would take roughly a third of the budget, showing that lofty restraint language sat beside war prioritization and concealed tradeoffs against civilian priorities.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.5"]},{"title":"Putin says Russia positions nuclear bombs in Belarus as warning to West","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Jun. 16, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-says-russia-positions-nuclear-bombs-in-belarus-as-warning-to-west-3107500","summary":"Putin framed Belarus nuclear deployment as a warning to the West and simultaneously downplayed use “for now.” That combination is classic strategic hedging: reassurance in wording, escalation in practice.","question_ids":["7B.8","1B.1","1B.4"]},{"title":"Russia formalizes tactical nuclear weapons deployment in Belarus","publisher":"Reuters","date":"May 25, 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/russia-signs-deal-to-deploy-tactical-nuclear-weapons-in-belarus-says-they-stay-under-its-control/1593879/","summary":"Moscow formalized forward deployment while saying it retained control, which undercut restraint claims and expanded coercive leverage. It is a concrete case of saying one thing about control while doing another strategically.","question_ids":["7B.8","1B.1","1B.6"]},{"title":"Putin accuses Ukraine of destroying the Kakhovka dam at behest of West","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Jun. 7, 2023","url":"https://theprint.in/world/putin-accuses-ukraine-of-destroying-the-kakhovka-dam-at-behest-of-west/1617195/","summary":"After the dam breach, Putin blamed Ukraine and Western sponsors while ordering rescue efforts. The rescue action is real, but the public posture is blame-shifting and concealment of responsibility rather than candid tradeoff admission.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"Putin repeats assertion that Russia did not start war in Ukraine","publisher":"Reuters","date":"May 10, 2023","url":"https://uk.investing.com/news/world-news/putin-repeats-assertion-that-russia-did-not-start-war-in-ukraine-3180367","summary":"Putin reiterated the false claim that Russia did not start the war and recast it as a necessary “special military operation.” This is direct manipulation of public information and refusal to own a major tradeoff or decision.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"Timeline: Putin’s key moments in Ukraine as war enters 4th year","publisher":"Reuters Connect","date":"Jun. 24, 2023","url":"https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/timeline-putins-key-moments-in-ukraine-as-war-enters-4th-year/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjM6bmV3c21sX1ZBMjUyMDI0MDYyMDIzUlAx","summary":"Reuters noted Putin dismissed claims that Russian forces committed war crimes as “fakes.” That is a direct denial of abuse rather than accountability, and it fits the broader pattern of concealing damaging facts.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7"]},{"title":"Russia’s 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices","publisher":"U.S. Department of State","date":"Apr. 22, 2024","url":"https://www.state.gov/reports/2023-country-reports-on-human-rights-practices/russia","summary":"The report says authorities jailed opposition figures, restricted media, opened 844 criminal cases for antiwar expression, and used laws indiscriminately. That is strong background evidence that the regime managed public information coercively and hid the real costs of policy.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6"]},{"title":"Freedom House: Russia 2023","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2023","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/freedom-world/2023","summary":"Freedom House says the Kremlin used a controlled media environment, subservient judiciary, and selective penalties, and that corruption and takeovers were routine. This supports the reading that Putin concealed tradeoffs and governed through narrative control rather than transparent commitment.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6","7B.5"]},{"title":"Freedom House: Russia Nations in Transit 2023","publisher":"Freedom House","date":"2023","url":"https://freedomhouse.org/country/russia/nations-transit/2023","summary":"Freedom House says Putin’s coalition, business elites, and propaganda system were tied together by personalist survival politics. That is strong evidence that public promises were subordinated to regime preservation.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.5"]},{"title":"Russia designates The Moscow Times newspaper a foreign agent","publisher":"Reuters","date":"Nov. 18, 2023","url":"https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/russia-designates-the-moscow-times-newspaper-a-foreign-agent-3238256","summary":"The Justice Ministry imposed new burdens on an already blocked outlet. That is not just media pressure; it also signals the state’s willingness to suppress reporting that could expose reversals or tradeoffs.","question_ids":["7B.8","7B.7","7B.6"]}]}
